claire.design: Tiny design check — Trace header CTAs: should Copy correlation id be the primary affordance instead of Export? raj.product: Yes. Support/product teams copy IDs constantly. Export is less frequent. claire.design: My mock flips them: Copy as visible text chip, Export in a dropdown with format labels. Mobile hides Export in kebab. morgan.pm: Data backs it — copy ~4x exports last 30 days. sam.eng: Backend note: exports can be async for big traces. If Export is secondary, show queued state and do not block the UI. aria.a11y: Accessibility checklist: the copy chip must be keyboard-focusable, include an aria-label that contains the full id and action, and update an aria-live="polite" region on success. Do not truncate the id for screen readers. claire.design: Example SR snippet I'll use:
then set sr-toast.textContent = 'Correlation ID abc-123 copied'; sam.eng: We'll implement sr-toast and return job ids for exports. Also emit analytics: trace.copy_corr_id, trace.export_requested, trace.export_ready (include format/file_size). aria.a11y: Also ensure copy chip color contrast meets 4.5:1 and focus ring is visible. Add a keyboard hint (press ? for shortcuts) and document any new shortcut (eg. press C when trace focused to copy). claire.design: I'll update the mock and post the spec with keyboard and SR flows. Can we canary this? raj.product: Yes — start 5% canary, watch copy/export metrics and export error rates. claire.design: Thanks all — will drop assets in the thread shortly. :sparkles:
